test_title: PYST 1: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate direct form of the given sentence.**

The driver asked a passerby if he could tell him the way to the market.

options.text: The driver said to a passerby, "Tell me the way to the market, will you"
The driver said to a passerby, "Please, will you tell me the way to the market?"
The driver said to a passerby, "Can you tell me the way to the market?"
The driver said to a passerby, "Could he tell him the way to the market?"

solution:
The correct answer is** The driver said to a passerby, "Can you tell me the way to the market?".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Since **could **is used in indirect speech, there must be the use of **'****can' or 'could'** in direct speech.
 
• The use of '**if'** suggests that it is an **interrogative sentence **starting with **'can'**.
 
• **'He'** has been used for** passerby **and therefore, the second form of person '**you'** must be used in direct speech. 
 
• Thus, the most appropriate direct form of the given sentence is expressed in **option 3.**

 

​The correct sentence is** The driver said to a passerby, "Can you tell me the way to the market?" **
